about: Fume cupboard modelled as a generic product: base solvent store with two doors and label, epoxy work surface with spill lip and aerofoil sill, side posts with service taps and socket plate, back baffle, glazed counter-balanced sash with handle, upper glazing, canopy fascia with airflow monitor, alarm LED and light switch, galvanised extract spigot. Geometry is drawn at the 1500_Ducted type; the other types share it until a parametric pass. Reference: query: casework fume cupboard casework hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=casework+fume+cupboard+casework+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
